definitions.explanation: An approximate judgment or calculation about something.
The direction or target one is aiming at.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}の{居場所|いばしょ}について、{警察|けいさつ}はまだ{見当|けんとう}がついていないようだ。
examples.english: It seems the police still have no idea about the criminal's whereabouts.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}はだいたい{見当|けんとう}がついているが、まだ{確認|かくにん}していない。
examples.english: I have a rough idea of the cause, but I haven't confirmed it yet.

examples.japanese: {見当|けんとう}をつけて{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To search with a rough aim in mind.

examples.japanese: {大体|だいたい}の{見当|けんとう}で{方向|ほうこう}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: I decided the direction based on a rough estimate.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}がなかったので、{太陽|たいよう}の{位置|いち}で{見当|けんとう}をつけて{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: Since I had no map, I walked using the position of the sun to aim my direction.

examples.japanese: {見当|けんとう}{外|はず}れな{方向|ほうこう}に{進|すす}んでしまった。
examples.english: I ended up heading in a completely wrong direction.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}を{目印|めじるし}にして{見当|けんとう}をつけたが、{霧|きり}が{出|で}てきて{見|み}えなくなった。
examples.english: I used the mountaintop as a landmark to aim my direction, but fog came in and I couldn't see it anymore.

notes:
{見当|けんとう} relates to estimation and aiming.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見当|けんとう}がつく/つかない (have/have no idea)
- {見当|けんとう}をつける (make an estimate)
- {見当|けんとう}{違|ちが}い (mistake, wrong guess)
- {見当|けんとう}{外|はず}れ (off the mark)

NOTE: Different from {検討|けんとう} (examination, consideration).
